_jobApplication.jobDescription: Replit, the agentic software creation platform (millions of users), Worldwide/Remote, $300K-$400K. Head of Forward Deployed Engineering, reporting to the President and Head of AI. Build and lead the FDE org that helps strategic enterprise customers operationalize Replit. FDEs are software engineers who embed with customers to build production systems, deploy AI-native workflows, and turn customer problems into reusable platform capabilities; they are the most advanced users of Replit and AI-native workflows and use AI agents/automation aggressively for leverage. Responsibilities: hire and develop a high-talent-density FDE team; define the hiring bar, operating principles, and execution standards; build a culture of speed, ownership, pragmatism, and customer impact; create systems/tooling to scale without heavy process; work directly with strategic customers (engineering leaders, product, executives); help customers redesign workflows around AI-native software development; lead complex engagements (integrations, infrastructure, agents, automation, internal developer platforms); unblock high-stakes deployments from experimentation to production; lead teams building real applications inside customer environments; drive rapid prototyping; jump into architecture reviews, debugging, live builds; identify repeatable patterns and turn them into reusable platform capabilities; upstream learnings to Product/Engineering; contribute production code, tooling, integrations, reference architectures; partner with Sales/Field Engineering/Product on strategic accounts; act as executive escalation point; help scale enterprise adoption globally. Required: 12+ years in engineering, infrastructure, developer tools, applied AI, or customer engineering; experience leading FDE/Applied AI/Solutions Architecture/Strategic Engineering teams; deep curiosity for AI-native development; experience leading high-performing technical orgs; strong technical judgment credible with senior engineers and executives; shipping production systems in fast-moving environments; product instincts and systems thinking; comfort with ambiguity and minimal process; excellent communication and customer leadership; strong ownership and urgency. Nice to have: AI agents/LLM workflows/developer tooling platforms; Fortune 500 engineering support; startup or founder experience; working with Product to shape roadmap.
_jobApplication.notes: Strong fit: FDE practice (Anand Creations) is literally this motion; production AI delivery + reusable capabilities (LumApps, Beekeeper templating engine); team building and hiring bar (hired/mentored the AI cohort, deputy tech lead, led 3 teams); founder/0-to-1 (Dronistics + 3 companies); aggressive AI-native tooling use; product instincts (MBA, product owner). Honest stretch: this is a Head-of-org leadership role and the candidate's leadership is at tech-lead / hiring-manager / founder scale rather than having previously run a large FDE organization; 12+ years is met (13+).
